2607.01127.title: $\text{Log}_\text{b}$Quant: Quantizing Language Models in Logarithmic Space
2607.01127.paper_summary: Quantization has become an invaluable tool to reduce memory requirements and inference speed of modern language models, in particular to make them available for consumer setups and edge devices. While previous work has primarily focused on uniform quantization codebooks, such approaches are prone to suboptimal representations due to low-frequency high-magnitude weights. We introduce Log$_\text{b}$Quant, a novel logarithmic quantization approach with adjustable bases, to adapt to common parameter distributions. We show that our method exhibits superior performance at 4-bit precision on several performance benchmarks compared to asymmetric linear quantization at tensor-wise granularity, while achieving moderate speedup and high memory savings, making it suitable for private use on consumer-grade GPUs.
2607.01127.paper_summary_zh: 量化已成為減少現代語言模型的記憶體需求和推理速度的重要工具，特別是使其能夠在消費者設置和邊緣設備上使用。雖然之前的研究主要集中在均勻量化碼本上，但這類方法容易因低頻高幅度權重而導致次優表示。我們介紹了Log$_\text{b}$Quant，一種具有可調基數的新型對數量化方法，以適應常見的參數分佈。我們展示了我們的方法在4位精度下在幾個性能基準上表現優於張量級別的非對稱線性量化，同時實現了適度的加速和高記憶體節省，使其適合在消費級GPU上私用。
